aboutmeP:
My name is Žiga Hvalec and I am from Maribor. I am a student of the Faculty of electrical engineering, computer science, and informatics. The joy of programming and computers has grown from a hobby to a serious study where I acquire new knowledge and practical experience. In my spare time, I like to do sports, running, skiing, snowboarding and going to fitness. 
I am interested in everything related to computers, modern technologies and technical innovations in this area. 
Because I wanted to use my knowledge in practice, I got summer work at a computer company. The experience is unique, I performed work related to databases and making windows applications in C#.
In the future, I want to try out the best in practice, so I am open to cooperation and new opportunities.
